eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 39th International Conference on Microelectronic Test Structures (ICMTS)
eventDetail.about: Components, Circuits, Devices and Systems; Engineered Materials, Dielectrics and Plasmas
eventDetail.sponsors: IEEE Electron Devices Society; International Centre for Mechanical Sciences (CISM); Università degli Studi di Udine

eventDetail.scope: For more than 35 years ICMTS has been the most important open forum to report scientific results achieved by means of test structures. It provides the community with the opportunity to meet and present new ideas in the field of characterization techniques and, in particular, in the design, characterization and fabrication of test structures for micro and nano-electronics. The Conference will bring together designers and users of test structures to discuss recent developments and future directions, in a one-track program, with convivial breaks allowing attendees to discuss and exchange viewpoints and challenges also with equipment vendors.
